entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: Elven Elder Druid of the Juniper Order in Kjeldor who helped cast the World Spell.

entities.name: Halvor Arenson
entities.description: Human priest who raised Kaysa in Mikkel.

entities.name: Kolbjörn
entities.description: Elder Druid who took Kaysa in as his child.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker who cast the World Spell.

entities.name: Heart of Yavimaya
entities.description: Awakened and killed many with vines until cleansed.

events.summary: Elder Druid Kolbjörn discovers Kaysa's Mark and takes her in.
events.quote: discovered that she had the crescent Mark of the Elder Druid

events.summary: Kaysa helps Freyalise cast the World Spell to end the Ice Age.
events.quote: she helped Freyalise cast the World Spell to end the Ice Age

events.summary: Kaysa marries Jaeuhl Carthalion and they lead survivors to Yavimaya.
events.quote: She married the knight Jaeuhl Carthalion

events.summary: Kaysa is kidnapped by a gorilla shaman but persuades a chieftain to ally against the Heart of Yavimaya.
events.quote: she convinced a gorilla chieftain to ally his people with the elves

relations.quote: She married the knight Jaeuhl Carthalion
She became an Elder Druid of the Juniper Order
